VI.description: Save and then close the project at a PATH\2C whether or not it is the active one.\0A\0AWHY IT EXISTS. A project that is LOADED but NOT ACTIVE cannot be made active by opening it again\3A Project.Open hands back the reference LabVIEW already holds\2C and Open Window on it activates nothing. Measured 2026-10-11 over ActiveX\2C 5 of 5 opens of such a project answered no error with no project active\2C after lvai_create_class had left it in that state - and lvai_close_active_project could not release it either\2C because nothing was active. A fresh open of a project that is NOT loaded made it active at once (2026-10-10)\2C so the remedy is to close this one by path and open it again.\0A\0ASave runs before Close for the reason lvai_close_active_project gives\3A Close has no save parameter\2C and an unsaved project would raise a modal prompt that stops LabVIEW's automation until a human dismisses it. The reference is closed out of the error chain\2C as there.

Control.description: Absolute path of the .lvproj to save and close.
Error cluster in. Nothing is closed when it carries an error.

Indicator.description: Error cluster out\3A Project.Open's error when the file is missing or not a project\2C else Save's or Close's.
